title: Share the Symbol, Not the Vector: Training-Free Fact Communication Across Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems allow language models to solve tasks collaboratively by sharing complementary information. These systems typically communicate through text, while recent approaches also explore exchanging internal model states. However, sharing these states across architectures often requires learned translators or assumptions about model compatibility. We introduce SYNC (Symbol-Indexed Neural Communication), a word-indexed interface that connects heterogeneous models without fine-tuning or a learned translator. From descriptions only it can see, the sender selects words from a shared list and sends their indices for each object, without seeing the questions. The receiver writes the described facts into its hidden states using its own word directions, vectors fitted once from its activations. We test selective use by swapping one attribute between two objects and requiring correct answers about both changed and unchanged attributes b

translated_title: 共享符号，而非向量：跨语言模型的无训练事实通信
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统允许语言模型通过共享互补信息来协作解决任务。这些系统通常通过文本进行通信，而最近的方法也在探索交换内部模型状态。然而，跨架构共享这些状态通常需要学习到的翻译器或对模型兼容性的假设。我们提出了SYNC（符号索引神经通信，Symbol-Indexed Neural Communication），这是一种词索引接口，无需微调或学习翻译器即可连接异构模型。发送方仅根据它所能看到的描述，从共享词表中选择单词，并为每个对象发送其索引，而无需看到问题。接收方使用自己的词方向（即从其激活中一次性拟合得到的向量）将所描述的事实写入其隐藏状态。我们通过在两个对象之间交换一个属性，并要求对已更改和未更改的属性都给出正确答案，来测试选择性使用能力（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了SYNC——一种无需训练的符号索引通信接口，使异构语言模型通过共享词表的索引而非内部向量来传递事实信息，从而无需微调或学习翻译器即可实现跨模型协作。
en_tdlr: SYNC, a training-free symbol-indexed interface, enables heterogeneous language models to communicate facts through indices of a shared vocabulary rather than internal vectors, without requiring fine-tuning or learned translators.
